description: Returns an on-chain market and risk snapshot of an ERC-20: USD price from its deepest DEX pool against wrapped native or stablecoins, FDV, total DEX liquidity, the top pools across Uniswap V2/V3, Aerodrome, Velodrome, PancakeSwap, Sushi, Camelot, QuickSwap, Trader Joe and Pangolin, holder-concentration hints (supply held in pools, burn address, the contract and the owner), and risk flags (proxy, owner, mint, blacklist, fee, pause or trading-switch functions in the bytecode, thin liquidity, price divergence between pools). Use it before buying, accepting or listing an unfamiliar token, or when an agent needs a price without a market-data API key. Data comes from contract reads only, so tokens with no DEX pool on the chosen chain have no price. Cost and side effects: this calls the hosted paid endpoint and costs 0.003 USDC per call via x402 on Base. It pays only if X402_PRIVATE_KEY (or EVM_PRIVATE_KEY) is set in this server's environment. It checks that the quote is USDC on Base, goes to the DevX wallet and is at most 0.01 USDC before signing. Without a key it pays nothing and returns {payment_required: true, url, quote, how_to_pay}. Risk flags are bytecode and liquidity heuristics, not an audit.

chain.description: Chain the contract is deployed on. Default: base.

pools.description: How many top pools to include, 1-10. Default 5.

token.description: ERC-20 contract address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters (not a symbol or name).

name: token_snapshot
title: Token price, liquidity and risk snapshot (paid, 0.003 USDC)
